text: {"rules":[{"id":"DM-SCREEN-35-70-OW","version":"August 2021","title":"Prediabetes and type 2 diabetes screening in adults aged 35-70 with overweight or obesity","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends screening for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes in adults aged 35 to 70 years who have overweight or obesity.","grade":"B","effective_date":"2021-08","action":"Screen for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes (plasma glucose or HbA1c)","denominator":"{\"all\":[{\"age\":{\"min\":35,\"max\":70,\"at\":\"end\"},\"quote\":\"aged 35 to 70 years\"},{\"condition\":{\"concept\":\"obesity\",\"onset_by\":\"{MY}-12-31\"},\"quote\":\"who have overweight or obesity\"},{\"uncomputable\":{\"needs\":\"confirmation patient is asymptomatic for diabetes (symptom status)\"},\"quote\":\"asymptomatic adults\"}],\"quote\":\"adults aged 35 to 70 years who have overweight or obesity\"}","numerator":"{\"observation\":{\"concept\":\"glucose_test\",\"window\":[\"{MY}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"],\"pick\":\"any\"},\"quote\":\"screening for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes\",\"derived\":{\"window\":\"Section text states no screening interval; a measurement-year window is assumed and must be confirmed by human review\"}}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["Screening interval is not stated in the section text; the measurement-year window on the numerator is an assumption declared as derived and needs human review.","'Asymptomatic' status (no diabetes symptoms) is not reliably held in structured EHR data, so it is encoded as uncomputable. This makes the denominator not fully computable.","The section does not explicitly exclude patients with an existing diabetes diagnosis, so no exclusion was added. A human reviewer may want to exclude the 'diabetes' concept because screening implies the patient is undiagnosed.","The 'obesity' concept is used for 'overweight or obesity'. The concept definition covers overweight, but no BMI thresholds are given in the text.","Not represented: 'Clinicians should offer or refer patients with prediabetes to effective preventive interventions.' There is no concept for preventive intervention referral, and the intervention content is unspecified.","The DATE field carries an asterisk ('August 2021 *') with no footnote text in the section. Its meaning is unknown and not represented."]}
